Steinerner Jäger and Schieferstein

AutumnMedium
3 October 2026 · Losenstein, Upper Austria
4.1 km · ↑ 450 m · 3–4 h up and down
Time3–4 h up and down
Distanceapprox. 4.1 km
Elevation gainapprox. 450 m
DifficultyMedium
RouteOut and back
StartParkplatz Schieferstein (Am Arzberg, Reichraming)
Drive from Linzapprox. 1 h 15 min
ParkingMax. 4 h, €4

Summits

Steinerner Jäger (1,185 m), Schieferstein (1,206 m)

About the place

A ridge hike above the Enns valley. First the rock tower of Steinerner Jäger, then a short walk along the ridge to Schieferstein. From the summit you can see into the Gesäuse mountains and across the foothills all the way to the Danube.

Photos

The route is approximated along hiking trails on the map (from Parkplatz Schieferstein at Am Arzberg, Reichraming, via Steinerner Jäger to Schieferstein and back the same way), not recorded on a phone.

Kleiner Sonnstein (922 m)

About the place

A short, steep hike above Traunkirchen with one of the best views of the Traunsee: straight down onto the Traunkirchen peninsula and across the lake to the Traunstein.

The route is approximated along hiking trails on the map (from the car park in Traunkirchen to Kleiner Sonnstein and back the same way), not recorded on a phone. Time is the Mapy.com hiking estimate (1 h 50 min up, 1 h 30 min down); difficulty as rated by Bergwelten.
